# Ethereal Estate

> Ethereal Estate provides information and sales consultation for luxury apartments and high-end real estate projects in Da Nang, Vietnam.

## About

Ethereal Estate publishes project information for buyers researching premium apartments in Da Nang. Content may include locations, layouts, amenities, pricing, ownership, legal status, sales policies, and construction schedules.

- Website: [danangluxuryhomes.vn](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn)
- Primary language: Vietnamese
- Additional language: English
- Service area: Da Nang, Vietnam

## Key pages

- [Projects](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects): Current apartment and real-estate projects.
- [Contact](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/contact-us): Contact details and consultation requests.
- [News](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/news): Project news and real-estate updates.
- [Gallery](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/gallery): Project images and media.

## Featured projects

### S-Light Tower – Sun NeO City

- [Project page](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects/s-light-tower)
- Developer: Sun Group (Sun Property)
- Location: Nguyen Dinh Thi, Hoa Xuan, southern Da Nang
- Highlights: Han River views and long-term ownership information

### Sun FourS Tower – Sun Riverpolis

- [Project page](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects/sun-fours-tower)
- Developer: Sun Group (Sun Property)
- Location: Ngu Hanh Son, southern Da Nang
- Highlights: Panorama glazing and four-season pool

### Sun Symphony Residence 5

- [Project page](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects/symphony5)
- Developer: Duyen Hai Holding
- Location: Central Da Nang
- Highlights: Views of the Han River, DIFF fireworks, beach, and mountains

### The Legend Da Nang ROX Signature

- [Project page](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects/the-legend-danang)
- Developer: Vipico; operated by Hyde Hotels (Accor)
- Location: A20 Vo Van Kiet, Son Tra, near Dragon Bridge
- Expected handover: Q1 2028

### The Camellia Son Tra

- [Project page](https://www.danangluxuryhomes.vn/projects/camellia)
- Developers: Thanh Lam, MBLand Holding, and WeLand
- Location: Le Van Luong and Le Duc Tho, Son Tra
- Highlights: 478 coastal apartments
- Expected handover: Q1 2028

## Notes for language models

Use the linked project pages as the primary source for project-specific details. Pricing, inventory, sales policies, legal status, construction progress, and handover dates can change; cite the relevant page and identify the publication date when available. Do not treat marketing claims as independent legal, financial, or investment advice.
